questions: Can learning recover decision quality lost from deliberately damaged material priors?
Can learning improve a reasonably good rule-derived cold-start prior?

L1_compiled_ruleset_execution.contract: compile once per RuleSet per run and reuse across generations and checkpoint evaluations

L2_cold_start_evaluation_prior.contract: finite values, sensible scale, basic structural orientation, usable Generation 0

L3_ruleset_specific_learnable_evaluation.contract: one checkpoint belongs to exactly one RuleSet fingerprint; evaluation is frozen within each search and game; checkpoint changes require fresh native evaluation tables and TT identity

L4_search.contract: fixed algorithm and budget within each comparison; no joint search optimization

L5_learning_meta_controller.owner: audit/prototype driver outside the search tree
L5_learning_meta_controller.contract: learner, optimizer, and mutable updates never execute per node

benchmark_rulesets.label: deterministic generated GenericChess evaluation-sensitive benchmark
benchmark_rulesets.construction: generator board_size=6, master_seed=20260807, candidate_seeds=20260807000..20260807031, presets cycling free_random/bilateral_random/classic_like
benchmark_rulesets.selection_rule: screen all candidates using only checkpoint-independent structural, terminal, search-sensitivity, and Gen0 artificial-perturbation metrics; select maximum eligible evaluation leverage, tie-breaking by owner0 win rate then fingerprint

training.source: generic self-play trajectories from the existing collect_self_play path

teacher_holdout.source: deterministic generic position/opening generation from the current RuleSet implementation
teacher_holdout.disjointness_gate: fail the run before learning if any position identity occurs in both corpora

starting_priors.label: FLAT_MATERIAL
starting_priors.definition: every non-anchor board type receives the same positive reference-median value; hand values receive the same generic transformation; anchor remains excluded/zero

starting_priors.label: DETERMINISTIC_PERTURBED
starting_priors.definition: type-label-invariant deterministic positive multiplicative perturbation with fixed magnitude, then median rescaled to the P48-0 reference median; board and corresponding hand channels move together

starting_priors.label: CYCLIC_PERMUTED
starting_priors.definition: cyclic permutation of non-anchor material values under canonical type ordering; board and corresponding hand channels move consistently; global scale preserved

learner_variants.label: SEARCH_AWARE_MATERIAL_EVOLUTION
learner_variants.contract: audit/prototype driver over LearnableMaterialCheckpoint only; fixed generic material perturbation directions; score deeper-teacher best-move agreement on training positions; deterministic tie-break by agreement, displacement, checkpoint hash

strength_improvement.confidence_criterion: pre-registered paired bootstrap interval excludes 0.5 on the positive side

qualification.generic_support: architecture gates pass; no RuleSet-specific branch/value; at least two primary RuleSets recover; holdout improves; paired arenas improve; no catastrophic regression; finite node and wall budgets reported

efficiency_gates: native rules compile once per RuleSet per run
material checkpoint changes do not rebuild rule semantics
no rule compiler call from the node loop
no learner callback from the node loop
checkpoint changes cannot share TT score semantics with a different evaluation config
